# Windows capture (synthetic)

`aji-hardware-capture.json` is hand-written in the exact format of
`scripts/capture-hardware-windows.ps1`. It is NOT a capture from a real PC: the owner has not sent
one yet. It describes an RTX 5070 machine, plus the Microsoft Basic Render Driver adapter.
Its `umdVersion` (32.0.15.9144) and nvidia-smi driver (591.44) agree under
`nvidia_driver_from_umd`. All values are invented; nothing identifying is in it.
It is replaced by `windows-pc/aji-hardware-capture.json` when the real file arrives.
